To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@finburst.com>, Emma Cho <emma.cho@finburst.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Sep 2027 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Quick pulse: Mutual Action Plan — owners & rollout window

Hi Liam / Emma,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the candid priorities. As discussed, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines the evaluation scope, success criteria, and a proposed 6-week pilot window. Key asks for you: please confirm the internal owners for evaluation tasks and whether the proposed mid-Oct start window still looks realistic on your side.

Highlights attached:
- Week 0: data access + security review (owner: Finburst Infra)
- Week 1–2: smoke tests + integration validation (owner: Finburst Eng)
- Week 3–5: feature evaluation + latency/cost checkpoints (owner: Finburst Product)
- Week 6: findings + handoff (owner: stakeholder TBD)

I copied Marissa (AE) and Ben (Solutions Eng) so we can align resources. If the owners/dates should shift, we can tighten or stretch the window — happy to update the MAP accordingly.

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_Finburst_v1.pdf

Next steps: can you confirm owners and estimated dates by end of week? If helpful, Marissa and I can jump on a quick 20-min call to align.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the tidy MAP. We sketched owners internally but I need to confirm with my managers before locking dates. Quick answers up front:
- Security/data access owner: Emma (security lead) — copying her.
- Eng lead: likely me as primary, with Rajiv as secondary.
- Product owner: TBD — I need to check with Priya (product).

We are interested in the mid-Oct window but I can't commit fully until I have Priya's buy-in. I should be able to confirm owners/dates by next Tuesday.

One question: can the pilot scope be narrowed to focus on embeddings and latency/cost metrics early? That would help speed internal sign-off.

Cheers,
Liam

- Security/data access: Emma Cho — access provisioning by 2027-10-10
- Eng lead: Liam O'Neill — integration test window 2027-10-11 to 2027-10-18
- Product owner: Priya Menon (will own feature evaluation) — start 2027-10-11, wrap by 2027-11-01

Happy to do a quick 15-min sync Tue 10am PT to confirm next steps — works for me.
